title: Jordan Love served as Packers' play caller for second half of preseason finale

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jordan Love served as Packers' play caller for second half of preseason finale
sources.description: Packers third-string quarterback Kyle McCord had an excellent game in the preseason finale, throwing for four touchdown passes and leading a fourth-quarter comeback as the Packers beat the Cardinals 42-38.
